t: Investors in Adept AI will be paid back after Amazon hires startup’s top talent | Semafor
s: August 2, 2024 - But unlike a typical “acqui-hire,” where a tech company buys a startup in order to get sought-after employees, Amazon didn’t actually buy Adept and didn’t directly pay investors. ...
